collection.description: A villager volunteers to announce the start of a running contest.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1) volunteers to announce the start of a running contest. The winner is less interested in the prize than in catching their breath.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1) volunteers to announce the start of a running contest. Afterward, the competitors share water and compare stories.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1) volunteers to announce the start of a running contest. (Name1) feels nervous despite insisting it is only for fun.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (Name1) volunteers to announce the start of a running contest. The spectators cheer for everyone approaching the finish.
